status: partial control repair; complete electrical qualification remains open
replaces: Replace the original R_EN_TOP/R_EN_BOTTOM divider and its direct U3.EN connection. Replace the KILL divider values. This supersedes the 74LVC1G07 trial only for control; the main power, PG/ENABLE and discharge paths are still unqualified.

C_U5.status: Required local bypass; exact part and effective capacitance remain unqualified

C_KILL.status: Retained original filter; exact part and transient response remain unqualified

resistor_model.conditions: Sum initial tolerance, TCR, 8000 h general-mode endurance, one solder-heat test, and one 1000 h biased 85 C/85% RH test independently. This bounded sensitivity envelope is not a guarantee for simultaneous stresses, arbitrary lifetime or enclosure temperature.

buffer_limits.input_leakage_conditions: VI=5.5 V or GND, VCC=0 to 5.5 V; applying this bound to intermediate input voltages is a conditional DC sensitivity calculation.
buffer_limits.slow_inputs: True Schmitt input; no input transition-rate limit in section 5.3. This removes the old 10 ns/V restriction, not the need to bound shutdown delay or supply ramps.

controller_limits.external_pullup_rule: At EN=0 V, the external pull-up must source less than 1 mA. Do not use the internal pull-up current at zero volts as a divider-edge leakage bound.

conditional_path.basis: Sensitivity input from the previous control study, NOT a measured or sourced full-path resistance. C is assumed no greater than A while the controller branch is forward supplied. Excludes reverse/backfeed, droop and ramp states.

unqualified: Intermediate-voltage input leakage, logic thresholds between tabulated supplies, unpowered/ramping buffer and complete reverse/backfeed states
Controller EN, filter and buffer propagation with actual parasitic capacitances; no maximum end-to-end shutdown time is established
Post-sense conductor resistance, peak/inrush demand and capacitor hold-up during the 720 ms KILL blanking interval
PG-to-boost shutdown, fuse coordination, complete PCB/BOM/branches, reset dwell and thermal bounds
